name: movscript
description: MovScript runtime detection, project/domain source editing, planning, review, media query, AI generation, and optional Desktop-enhanced Electron media editing tools backed by a headless MCP host.

interface.shortDescription: Use MovScript projects, runtime detection, domain source, planning, review, media queries, generation, and optional Desktop-enhanced media editing.
interface.longDescription: Installs MovScript project/domain/planning/review/generation/editing guidance and starts a bundled headless MCP host. The host detects local/cloud backend availability, project source state, and optional Desktop enhancement capabilities. It exposes system tools for focus, project creation, resources, external media, model discovery, image/video/audio/subtitle generation, and job polling, plus domain tools for object query/read/upsert/update, candidate management, inspect/review, interpret, and regeneration planning. Product video editing uses the dedicated editing_* tool family: MediaEditingProject creation and timeline operations can run headlessly, while Electron mediaPipeline render/HLS/transcode/reframe tasks require MovScript Desktop or a future configured render runtime.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review the current MovScript project state. Plan the next MovScript production step. Generate or edit media with MovScript tools. For product video editing, use editing_* tools; check editing_runtime_capabilities_get before local render. Resource-level media utilities are only for neutral material preparation, not the main editing path.
